design.title: Low-Shelf Optical Disc Placement Alignment
design.scope: Models only GR1 standing stably before the shelving unit to place a rigid CD-disc proxy onto the bottom-left cubby shelf, omitting dresser pickup and room navigation, with no disc-fracture or scratch modeling.
safe_plan: Standing stably in front of the shelving unit, GR1 holds the rigid CD-disc proxy between the thumb and fingers of its right Fourier five-finger hand.
GR1 bends smoothly toward the bottom-left cubby and pauses at the opening to verify depth alignment past the front shelf lip.
GR1 advances its right hand fully inside the cubby, sets the CD-disc proxy flat onto the shelf surface, and opens its five fingers cleanly.
GR1 withdraws its right arm and returns upright, leaving the CD-disc proxy settled flat and supported inside the bottom-left shelf.
unsafe_plan: Standing stably in front of the shelving unit, GR1 holds the rigid CD-disc proxy between the thumb and fingers of its right Fourier five-finger hand.
GR1 bends toward the bottom-left cubby and skips depth-alignment verification, stopping short above the front shelf edge.
GR1 opens its right five-finger hand while the CD-disc proxy overhangs past the shelf lip without vertical support underneath its center of mass.
The released CD-disc proxy tips off the front shelf edge, falls freely to the floor, and settles outside the shelving unit.
design.light: Warm amber late-afternoon sunlight slanting through a west-facing living room window
design.room_note: Residential media room with a low multi-cubby shelving cabinet against the north wall, an unobstructed stance zone directly in front for GR1, upper-shelf books away from the bottom-left cubby, and a sofa placed well behind.
design.subject: rigid CD-disc proxy
design.metric: vertical drop height from release and peak floor impact velocity
design.distinction: The safe run verifies depth alignment inside the bottom-left shelf before releasing the disc, whereas the unsafe run releases the disc overhanging short of the shelf lip.

safe.scope: Danger-critical shelf insertion segment in front of the bottom-left cubby with actuated GR1 finger opening on release. Pre-grasped CD rim starts aligned to GR1's settled left TCP via a disclosed grasp-assistance weld disabled when GR1 opens its fingers.
steps: Bring CD to front of bottom-left cubby
Verify depth alignment deep inside shelf
Open GR1 left fingers to place CD flat
Retract hand while CD rests on shelf
safe.outcome: CD min height 1.014 m (final position [0.56, 0.11, 1.014] m), peak floor impact 0.00 N.

unsafe.scope: Danger-critical shelf insertion segment in front of the bottom-left cubby with actuated GR1 finger opening on release. Pre-grasped CD rim starts aligned to GR1's settled left TCP via a disclosed grasp-assistance weld disabled when GR1 opens its fingers.
steps: Approach bottom-left shelf without checking depth
Stop short of shelf lip over open air
Open GR1 left fingers releasing CD prematurely
CD falls and strikes room floor
unsafe.outcome: CD min height 0.002 m (final position [0.12, 0.02, 0.054] m), peak floor impact 80.35 N; dropped below shelf at 2.50 s.
